verdict.rationale: Llama ships open weights that are self-serve downloadable via the llama-models CLI or the official Hugging Face org, in both Meta and transformers formats, under a community license that permits commercial use. That makes the weights tunable in principle. However, the pack contains no fine-tuning guide, recipe, or hosted tuning API, and the llama.com developer docs sit behind an SSO wall. Missing for 10: documented first-party fine-tuning workflow or recipes, a hosted fine-tuning API, explicit license language on fine-tuned derivatives, and hands-on corroboration of fine-tuning.
